scope_note: Second-pass governed synthesis for Google Council Bluffs. Construction job-years use only two directly observed September 2025 city permit valuations and transfer the published Prince William County prototype coefficients as benchmark equivalents; the four channels are separated and protected by one aggregation. No Pottawattamie County supplier-retention share is imposed because the public audit found contractor names but no payment or vendor-residence ledger. The water row is the unallocated Google Council Bluffs location identity reported for 2024, not a building allocation. No local abatement, exemption realization, franchise-fee amount, electric load, public-service cost, break-even threshold, or net fiscal result is modeled. County outcome gaps remain descriptive benchmark applications with fit-sensitivity ranges and no causal attribution.

sources.title: Google 2025 Environmental Report
sources.notes: The location schedule reports 2024 Council Bluffs water withdrawal of 1,410.3 million gallons, discharge of 400.1 million gallons, and consumption of 1,010.2 million gallons. Consumption is withdrawal minus discharge; discharge may be engineering-estimated. The row does not allocate a campus or building.
